label: Base of Skull
alt: Interactive inferior view of the external base of the skull and upper palate
annotationScope: External skull base: central occipital and sphenoid openings, occipital condyles, hard palate, vomer, and reviewed bilateral temporal landmarks

annotationSources.title: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e — The Skull

hotspots.label: Foramen magnum
hotspots.description: Large opening in the occipital bone that connects the cranial cavity with the vertebral canal.

hotspots.label: Occipital condyle (right)
hotspots.description: Oval articular surface beside the foramen magnum that articulates with the atlas.

hotspots.label: Occipital condyle (left)
hotspots.description: Oval articular surface beside the foramen magnum that articulates with the atlas.

hotspots.label: Foramen ovale (right)
hotspots.description: Large oval opening in the greater wing of the sphenoid for the mandibular division of the trigeminal nerve.

hotspots.label: Foramen ovale (left)
hotspots.description: Large oval opening in the greater wing of the sphenoid for the mandibular division of the trigeminal nerve.

hotspots.label: Foramen spinosum (right)
hotspots.description: Small opening posterolateral to the foramen ovale for the middle meningeal vessels.

hotspots.label: Foramen spinosum (left)
hotspots.description: Small opening posterolateral to the foramen ovale for the middle meningeal vessels.

hotspots.label: Palatine process of maxilla
hotspots.description: Anterior three-quarters of the hard palate, formed by the paired maxillae.

hotspots.label: Horizontal plate of palatine bone
hotspots.description: Posterior quarter of the hard palate, formed by the paired palatine bones.

hotspots.label: Vomer
hotspots.description: Midline bone forming the posterior-inferior portion of the nasal septum.

hotspots.label: Mastoid process (right)
hotspots.description: Rounded inferior projection of the mastoid part of the temporal bone; a major neck-muscle attachment site.

hotspots.label: Styloid process (right)
hotspots.description: Slender inferior projection of the temporal bone that anchors styloid muscles and ligaments.

hotspots.label: External acoustic meatus (right)
hotspots.description: Lateral opening of the temporal bone that leads into the external auditory canal.

hotspots.label: Mandibular fossa (right)
hotspots.description: Oval depression anterior to the external acoustic meatus that receives the mandibular condyle at the temporomandibular joint.

hotspots.label: Stylomastoid foramen (right)
hotspots.description: Small opening between the styloid and mastoid processes through which the facial nerve exits the skull.

hotspots.label: Carotid canal entrance (right)
hotspots.description: Inferior entrance anteromedial to the styloid process for passage of the internal carotid artery.

hotspots.label: Jugular foramen (right)
hotspots.description: Irregular opening between the temporal and occipital bones that transmits cranial nerves IX–XI and the internal jugular vein.

hotspots.label: Mastoid process (left)
hotspots.description: Rounded inferior projection of the mastoid part of the temporal bone; a major neck-muscle attachment site.

hotspots.label: Styloid process (left)
hotspots.description: Slender inferior projection of the temporal bone that anchors styloid muscles and ligaments.

hotspots.label: External acoustic meatus (left)
hotspots.description: Lateral opening of the temporal bone that leads into the external auditory canal.

hotspots.label: Mandibular fossa (left)
hotspots.description: Oval depression anterior to the external acoustic meatus that receives the mandibular condyle at the temporomandibular joint.

hotspots.label: Stylomastoid foramen (left)
hotspots.description: Small opening between the styloid and mastoid processes through which the facial nerve exits the skull.

hotspots.label: Carotid canal entrance (left)
hotspots.description: Inferior entrance anteromedial to the styloid process for passage of the internal carotid artery.

hotspots.label: Jugular foramen (left)
hotspots.description: Irregular opening between the temporal and occipital bones that transmits cranial nerves IX–XI and the internal jugular vein.
